newsitem.title: UK: Dlr keeps gains after energetic week in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Dlr keeps gains after energetic week in Europe.

text.p: The dollar was trading sturdily against the mark and yen at the end of an energetic week, with firm inflation data from the U.S. giving it a final boost in Europe's afternoon trade.

It trimmed its gains as U.S. stocks and Treasury bonds fell, spooked by the producer price and retail sales data which strengthened the market's expectations that the Federal Reserve would raise interest rates next month.
But this dented sentiment only slightly and the dollar recovered to eye the 37-month high of 1.7272 marks it hit earlier this week.
